jobs.description:
Why AMS?

We strive to do things better for the world’s most demanding brands. Is it challenging? Yes. But it’s a challenge that brings us together, where support, collaboration and inclusiveness empower you with a feeling of belonging.

Bring your goals and ambitions. We give you the trust, independence, and flexibility to run your career your way. Our support will bring you opportunity.

Our evolution is happening now, let’s bring it - together.

The Role:

We are currently looking for a Senior Recruiter with German (m/f/d) to support one of our client's – a market leader in investment banking – NatWest Group.

As a Senior Recruiter (m/f/d) you will support with the full end to end lifecycle (for all roles from Analyst to VP Level) via the direct delivery model ensuring Client, key hiring Managers stakeholders and candidates are supported throughout their lifecycle. You will also be supporting creating a talent strategy for your region and driving the achievement of all contractually agreed quality thresholds, SLAs and client satisfaction targets.

You’ll be reporting into a Senior Manager and be working alongside you colleagues across multiple regions as well as being a part of the wider NatWest UK AMS team. You will also have reporting lines into the NatWest HR Team in region.

Key Accountabilities:

- Taking full ownership to ensure the 360-recruitment service is delivered in line with contractual obligations and client service level agreements
- Leading vacancy consultation discussions to agree the recruitment plans with hiring managers– this includes role requirements, sourcing strategy, DEI requirements, pay range, agreed timeframes, responsibilities of all involved, and the selection process.
- Drive down the use of existing reliance on Agency a and educate the HM population on the benefits of direct delivery.
- Leveraging your existing experience, knowledge, and resources whilst also working with experts in sourcing and talent intelligence to develop effective sourcing strategies that enable you to deliver great candidates and lead and influence conversations with your hiring managers.
- Providing subject matter expertise, thought leadership and talent intelligence in recruitment discussions and vacancy briefing calls with Hiring Managers, leaving the discussion with a detailed understanding of the client’s business, the requirements and unique selling points of the role.
- Creating and maintaining trusted partner relationships with Senior hiring managers/stakeholders. Independent execution of the end-to-end delivery of recruitment services to them, providing counsel, advising through insight and SME knowledge on the recruitment process and ensuring that timelines are correctly identified and met
- Championing your candidates. Having honest, quality career discussions that assess candidate suitability for each role and bring your client’s brand to life so that candidates feel excited at the prospect of joining them

Critical Skills & Experience:

- Fluency in English and German, both written & spoken
- Experience in leading end-to-end 360 recruitment processes.
- Experience of sourcing and creating talent pools for future hiring.
- Strong customer focus and the ability to manage Client stakeholders including senior position
- Excellent communication skills and ability to build long-lasting relationships with candidates, clients, and teammates.
- Experience of hiring within Financial Services with preferably Investment Banking.

Within Architecture & Application Portfolio Management, you shape the evolution of our Enterprise Architecture at Group level. At the core is the development of an effective Enterprise Architecture Management (EAM) practice in LeanIX — as the foundation for reliable transparency across business processes, applications, data and technologies.
How do you make sure your architecture expertise doesn't stay conceptual, but leads to target pictures and solution options that genuinely work in everyday business? A team driving architecture across domain boundaries is looking forward to supporting well-founded decisions and advancing our IT landscape together with you.

TASKS WITH IMPACT

- You build up Enterprise Architecture Management and LeanIX as the central architecture repository, establish it, and continuously develop the metamodel, fact sheets, roles and governance processes further.
- You create transparency across the IT landscape by structuring, documenting and making usable business processes, business capabilities, applications, data, technologies, interfaces and dependencies.
- You establish data quality standards and clear responsibilities, actively address data gaps, and position LeanIX as a reliable basis for decision-making in day-to-day business.
- You drive stakeholder enablement together with business functions and IT, run trainings, roadshows and reviews, and embed architecture processes sustainably into everyday work.
- You accompany selected architecture topics and business domains independently — from analysing the current landscape to developing target pictures, evaluating options, and preparing architecture sketches and impact assessments for business functions and IT.
- You further develop reusable architecture principles, standards and guardrails, and identify potential for standardisation and rationalisation.
- You assess new requirements and technologies for their impact on the enterprise architecture, prioritise them, and translate them into concrete architecture measures.

YOUR SKILLS

- You bring several years of experience in enterprise architecture and complex IT landscapes.
- Very good practical knowledge of LeanIX or comparable EAM tools, together with experience in target architectures, portfolio management and transformation processes, sets you apart; experience in a retail environment is a plus.
- Strategic thinking allows you to translate the overall architecture into clear target pictures and development options.
- Structured, traceable documentation of complex interrelations in LeanIX is a natural part of your way of working.
- Building sustainable relationships with business departments and IT is part of your day-to-day work, and you actively foster exchange within the architecture community.
- In daily operations, you embed architecture processes in a hands-on way and ensure they are used sustainably.
- Driving the ongoing development of the IT landscape, you identify synergies as well as standardization and rationalization potential.
- Whether with internal or international stakeholders, you communicate confidently in English and German in a business context.

jobs.occupation: Senior Process Manager (d/f/m) R&D Operational Excellence & Process Improvement (Forschungs- und Entwicklungsingenieur/in)
jobs.description:
In this role, you will drive the efficiency of the global Stage-Gate process for product development across LIXIL's brands and regions. You are the operational engine behind our R&D delivery: ensuring clear work packages, disciplined gate transitions, and practical governance that project teams can easily adopt. As the primary subject matter expert, you will serve as the trusted advisor for project managers and gatekeepers on all process inquiries.

The role works through influence across a matrixed, multi-cultural organisation and is a service to colleagues rather than an audit function. R&D is in active transformation on tooling and data quality, so ambiguity and shifting priorities are part of the job.

Your Responsibilities:

- Drive continuous optimisation of the global Stage-Gate Work Packages, ensuring deliverables are lean, consistent and harmonised across brands and regions.
- Maintain and enforce the global R&D governance framework: processes, tools, RASCI models, cadence structures and compliance checkpoints.
- Safeguard gate readiness, documentation integrity and audit readiness across all gate transitions.
- Define, track and report R&D KPIs covering gate discipline, cycle time and pipeline health.
- Develop and maintain digitalized templates, blueprints, work instructions and process documentation that simplify execution for project managers.
- Coordinate cross-functional and cross-regional alignment, so local delivery conforms to global R&D standards.
- Ensure Stage-Gate documentation and gate data are captured consistently and kept current in the governing systems, and represent process requirements towards the system owners.
- Build and maintain the R&D Knowledge Hub as the single, topic-structured source for process documentation, templates and training material, curated as an ongoing exercise.
- Ensure data continuity between Stage-Gate governance and Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), acting as the business-side representative to translate process requirements into system specifications with the Global PLM team.

Your Profile:

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Business Management, Industrial Management or comparable.
- 7 to 10 years in process management, R&D project management or operational excellence, gained across more than one industry, ideally in product development or manufacturing.
- Proven implementation of Stage-Gate or comparable phase-gate models
- Working understanding of project and portfolio management systems used in an R&D environment (e.g. Planisware Orchestra, SAP) and good data literacy for KPI definition and process analysis.
- Interest in how AI, automation and digital tools can simplify product development processes.
- Solid understanding of PLM, ERP, and engineering change management systems (e.g., SAP, Planisware Orchestra), with the ability to align process governance with system architecture.
- Demonstrated comfort, curiosity and respect across cultures and working styles is a core requirement.
- Gives and receives feedback constructively.
- Lean, Six Sigma or comparable optimisation approaches an advantage.
- Strong moderation and stakeholder skills, able to steer cross-regional teams without direct reporting lines. Able to translate between technical detail and business framing.
- Business-fluent English required, German an advantage.

Our offer:

- A salary package that ties directly to your work experience and responsibilities
- Comprehensive health management, including an on-site fitness room, local and digital health services, Health Cashback, and Hansefit membership
- Diversity & Inclusion: We offer equal opportunities for all individuals and support your personal development
- Access to a wide range of employee benefits, such as discounts on travel, fashion, media, mobile phones, and more
- A highly motivated, appreciative, and international team that inspires you and offers opportunities to learn and grow
- A modern company restaurant to ensure your well-being during the day

Interested?

Then we are looking forward to your application!

The Institute of Pathology / LaBo[o]ratory of Nephropathology (https://www.ukaachen.de/kliniken-institute/institut-fuer-pathologie/forschung/labooratory-of-nephropathology/) is offering a

to interrogate autoimmune kidney diseases using cutting-edge spatial transcriptomics and bioimage analysis techniques, including deep learning

Operational area: Institute of Pathology / LaBo[o]ratory of Nephropathology

Working hours: 75% of the collectively agreed full-time working hours (currently 38.5 hours per week)

Duration/Term of employment: Initially limited till 30.09.2029, with option of prolongation until the completion of the doctoral degree

Start date: as soon as possible

Remuneration/Rates: EG 13 (TV-L)

Project Title: Dissecting immune cell crosstalk in autoimmune kidney diseases with spatial transcriptomics and pathomics. Institute for Pathology, RWTH Aachen

Within this project the PhD candidate will interrogate immune cell crosstalk and crescent formation in patients with autoimmune kidney disease (including IgA nephropathy, ANCA-glomerulonephritis and others). The PhD candidate will learn to train and deploy histology segmentation models as part of the Aachen Digital Pathology group, as well as the downstream analysis of morphometric features in conjuncture with spatial transcriptomics.

This PhD-Program is meant to built a new generation of scientists that are rigorously trained in the development and application of cutting-edge computational tools to generate digital biomarkers with translational clinical impact. This combined skillset will enable the candidate to excel in their further academic or industry career after concluding the PhD training.

The PhD-Project is embedded within the section of Translational Nephropathology at the Institute of Pathology, offering a comprehensive training programs for PhD candidates, peer-to-peer mentoring, lectures and lab meetings on translational kidney research, as well as possibilities for networking and presentations at scientific meetings. We are an interdisciplinary and international team of scientists and clinicians with a long-standing focus and expertise in developing novel methods for digital pathology, advanced image analysis and deep learning. Our hardware equipment comprises high-end computational infrastructure, with several GPUs (NVIDIA DGX A100), CPU clusters and storage systems.

Why you should choose us?

We offer…

- 30 days of vacation per year for full-time employment
- A bonus of 3,000 euros for employees who help recruit employees in different sectors
- An attractive company pension scheme from VBL
- Education opportunities, including updating and upgrading
- Access to public transport
- In-house kindergarten (places subject to availability)
- Staff residences (places subject to availability and by arrangement)
- An onboarding app for new employees
- Extended opening hours in the staff restaurant

Tasks

- Development of a pathomics model for H&E- and PAS-stained histological slides of autoimmune kidney diseases
- Application and refinement of techniques for joint analysis of pathomics and spatial transcriptomics
- Implementation of biostatistical and machine learning models for predicting clinical outcomes using joint biomarkers
- Writing scientific publications and presentation of scientific data at medical conferences

Your profile

We are looking for a highly motivated and curious PhD candidate who is eager to learn and apply new computational methods, takes ownership of a project, and drives it forward with a structured, reliable working style. Strong communication skills in English (Lecel C1) and enthusiasm for interdisciplinary teamwork are highly valued.

- Applicants should have a master's degree in biology, medicine, or a related field (e.g. engineering, molecular medicine, physics)
- Interested in working at the intersection of computational pathology and multi-omics. Ideally, applicants should have prior experience in either spatial transcriptomics or computer vision, ideally computational pathology approaches
- Development of a pathomics model for H&E- and PAS-stained histological slides of autoimmune kidney diseases
- Application and refinement of techniques for joint analysis of pathomics and spatial transcriptomics
- Implementation of biostatistical and machine learning models for predicting clinical outcomes using joint biomarkers
- Writing scientific publications and presentation of scientific data at medical conferences
- Motivation and eagerness to lean
- Ability to work indepedently / self-directed working
- Attention to detail
- Teamwork

Application:
